explanation: Record every distinct original node reachable from the first head, stopping on a repeated reference. Traverse the second head with the same cycle guard and return its first node also reachable from the first. The wrapper verifies overlap identity and input preservation.
timeComplexity: O(m+n) expected time over distinct reachable nodes.
spaceComplexity: O(m+n) auxiliary identity sets, including structural validation.
attribution: Original C++ implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract and repository-authored C# algorithms. Uses the existing local native test-framework API. No upstream reference implementation was altered or translated.
